messages.subject: DHL Supply Chain Thailand | Decarbonized logistics, partnerships and country strategy
messages.body:
Dear DHL Supply Chain Thailand Leadership Team,

DHL Supply Chain's work on transport sustainability, operational visibility and integrated logistics aligns with my experience coordinating complex industrial operations across stakeholders, regulators and internal functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy within a remote mining operation where logistics, continuity and institutional coordination matter every day.

I also bring practical energy-transition experience through governance and stakeholder support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness based on physical operating evidence. This combination gives me a strong perspective on resilient operations, decarbonization and public-private partnership execution.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or Indochina mandates across Strategic Partnerships, Sustainability, External Affairs, Country Strategy or senior stakeholder leadership. I have attached a DHL Supply Chain Thailand-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the appropriate leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
